title: resourcePolicy
responsibility: Schedules priority-ordered root and nested reservations while preserving host headroom and ancestor budgets.

inputs.name: resourcePressure.sample
inputs.description: Timestamped host CPU, memory and pressure observation used for this admission decision.

inputs.name: resourcePressure.config
inputs.description: Validated reserve floors and telemetry timing limits; lower safety thresholds are rejected.

inputs.name: resourcePressure.now
inputs.description: Current epoch time in milliseconds for telemetry freshness, queue ordering or lease expiry.

inputs.name: memoryReserve.sample
inputs.description: Timestamped host CPU, memory and pressure observation used for this admission decision.

inputs.name: memoryReserve.config
inputs.description: Validated reserve floors and telemetry timing limits; lower safety thresholds are rejected.

inputs.name: impossibleRequest.request
inputs.description: Requested priority, CPU cores, memory in MiB and public label to validate against available capacity.

inputs.name: impossibleRequest.sample
inputs.description: Timestamped host CPU, memory and pressure observation used for this admission decision.

inputs.name: impossibleRequest.config
inputs.description: Validated reserve floors and telemetry timing limits; lower safety thresholds are rejected.

inputs.name: resourcePolicy.jobs
inputs.description: Ordered shared queued and running reservations, including each parent identity and requested budget.

inputs.name: resourcePolicy.sample
inputs.description: Timestamped host CPU, memory and pressure observation used for this admission decision.

inputs.name: resourcePolicy.config
inputs.description: Validated reserve floors and telemetry timing limits; lower safety thresholds are rejected.

inputs.name: resourcePolicy.now
inputs.description: Current epoch time in milliseconds for telemetry freshness, queue ordering or lease expiry.

outputs.name: resourcePressure
outputs.description: Reason new admissions must wait, or null when telemetry and reserve headroom are usable.

outputs.name: memoryReserve
outputs.description: Bytes reserved as the greater of the configured percentage and absolute memory floor.

outputs.name: impossibleRequest
outputs.description: Whether the request exceeds total usable host capacity after reserves.

outputs.name: resourcePolicy
outputs.description: IDs admitted by priority and bounded parent pools, plus the public waiting reason.
